description: This is an HTML file implementing the front-end UI for a Database Viewer application. It includes styling, structure, and embedded JavaScript code for dynamically loading and interacting with databases and tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list when clicked.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders the data of a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table with the JSON data, handling wide content and object types.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, handling different data types and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data types on click.
